statement: Never have I ever fallen asleep at a party before midnight.
Never have I ever lost my phone or wallet while out on a wild night.
Never have I ever pretended to know a song when everyone else was singing along.
Never have I ever spilled a drink on someone and walked away hoping they wouldn't notice.
Never have I ever snuck into a VIP section, concert, or festival without a ticket.
Never have I ever sung karaoke so badly that people actually looked concerned.
Never have I ever danced on a table or counter at a party.
Never have I ever ordered an absurd amount of late-night fast food that I couldn't finish.
Never have I ever worn sunglasses indoors to look cool.
Never have I ever left a party without saying goodbye to anyone (the Irish Exit).
Never have I ever drank something out of a shoe or strange object for a dare.
Never have I ever lied to a bouncer to get into a venue.
Never have I ever woke up the next morning wearing someone else's jacket or shoes.
Never have I ever played drinking games for more than 5 consecutive hours.
Never have I ever texted an ex after 2 AM.
Never have I ever walked into a glass door or window in public.
Never have I ever waved back at someone who wasn't waving at me.
Never have I ever tripped on flat ground and tried to turn it into a cool jog.
Never have I ever accidentally called a teacher or boss 'Mom' or 'Dad'.
Never have I ever smiled and nodded at someone for a full conversation because I couldn't hear what they said.
Never have I ever had food stuck in my teeth for hours without anyone telling me.
Never have I ever pushed a door that clearly said 'PULL' with maximum confidence.
Never have I ever dropped my phone right onto my face while lying down in bed.
Never have I ever accidentally liked an old photo while stalking someone on social media.
Never have I ever walked out of the restroom with toilet paper stuck to my shoe.
Never have I ever choked on my own spit while trying to speak.
Never have I ever farted in an elevator and blamed it on someone else.
Never have I ever completely forgotten someone's name 5 seconds after they introduced themselves.
Never have I ever sang out loud with headphones on thinking I sounded whisper quiet.
Never have I ever pulled up to a drive-thru and realized I forgot my wallet.
Never have I ever gone on a blind date set up by friends or family.
Never have I ever used a cheesy pick-up line that actually worked.
Never have I ever had a fake emergency planned with a friend to escape a terrible date.
Never have I ever kissed someone whose name I didn't know.
Never have I ever had an awkward romantic moment interrupted by parents or pets.
Never have I ever sent a risky screenshot to the exact person the screenshot was about.
Never have I ever googled my date's entire family background before meeting them.
Never have I ever pretended to love a sport or band just to impress someone I liked.
Never have I ever slid into a celebrity or influencer's DMs.
Never have I ever been caught staring at someone attractive in public.
Never have I ever had a crush on a friend's sibling.
Never have I ever cried during a cheesy romantic comedy film.
Never have I ever matched with a coworker on a dating app.
Never have I ever gone back to an ex more than two times.
Never have I ever missed a flight, train, or bus because I was sleeping or lost track of time.
Never have I ever packed for a week-long trip just 30 minutes before leaving for the airport.
Never have I ever gotten completely lost in a foreign city where I couldn't speak the language.
Never have I ever gone skinny dipping in the ocean or a lake.
Never have I ever eaten street food that looked extremely sketchy but tasted incredible.
Never have I ever had my luggage lost by an airline.
Never have I ever slept overnight in an airport terminal.
Never have I ever driven a car or scooter on the wrong side of the road in a foreign country.
Never have I ever jumped off a cliff or high rock into water.
Never have I ever gone camping and run away in terror from an innocent harmless bug.
Never have I ever ridden a rollercoaster with my eyes squeezed shut the entire time.
Never have I ever taken hotel toiletries or slippers home with me.
Never have I ever turned my video off during a Zoom meeting to take a nap or eat.
Never have I ever answered a phone call and immediately put it on mute hoping they'd hang up.
Never have I ever spent real-world money on cosmetic videogame skins.
Never have I ever rage-quit a competitive multiplayer videogame and thrown a controller.
Never have I ever stayed up past 4 AM watching random documentary or TikTok rabbit holes.
Never have I ever accidentally sent a voice note of myself talking to someone else.
Never have I ever googled symptoms for a minor headache and convinced myself I had 3 days to live.
Never have I ever had over 100 unread text notifications or 10,000 unread emails.
Never have I ever made a fake social media burner account to spy on someone.
Never have I ever left a group chat in pure dramatic rage.
Never have I ever used a coworker's or roommate's streaming account without their permission.
Never have I ever checked my phone during a movie in a dark cinema.
Never have I ever touched a hot stove or pan even after someone warned me it was hot.
Never have I ever eaten food off the floor past the 5-second rule.
Never have I ever cut my own bangs or hair and instantly regretted it.
Never have I ever pretended to understand wine tasting and said 'Ah, very earthy notes'.
Never have I ever told a lie so elaborate that I started believing it myself.
Never have I ever sneezed so hard that I hurt my back or ribs.
Never have I ever accidentally stepped into a shower with my socks on.
Never have I ever re-gifted a birthday or holiday present back to the same person who gave it.
Never have I ever bought something super expensive just to return it after taking an Instagram photo.
Never have I ever gotten a tattoo that I now wish I could erase.
Never have I ever hidden in a closet or under a bed to surprise scare someone.
Never have I ever eaten an entire pint of ice cream or full large pizza in a single sitting.
Never have I ever blamed a bad smell on a pet that wasn't even in the room.
Never have I ever stayed in my pajamas for an entire 48-hour weekend without stepping outside.
Never have I ever lied about having seen a classic movie like The Godfather or Star Wars.
Never have I ever had a dream about someone in this room and felt weird seeing them the next day.
Never have I ever pretended to be on an important phone call just to avoid talking to someone on the street.
Never have I ever locked myself out of my own home or car.
Never have I ever accidentally sent a text complaining about someone TO that exact person.
Never have I ever eaten raw cookie dough straight from the tube against all FDA warnings.
Never have I ever spent more than 20 minutes posing for the perfect selfie.
Never have I ever practiced an award acceptance speech in front of the bathroom mirror.
Never have I ever worn the exact same outfit two days in a row hoping no one would notice.
Never have I ever laughed at a funeral or solemn occasion because someone made eye contact with me.
Never have I ever accidentally taken someone else's drink thinking it was mine.
Never have I ever cried over a cartoon character dying.
Never have I ever tried to open a locked door using a credit card or bobby pin like in action movies.
Never have I ever spent more than $100 on something totally useless just because it was on sale.
Never have I ever googled my own name to see what comes up on image search.
Never have I ever gotten stuck in a piece of clothing while trying it on in a changing room.
Never have I ever secretly rooted for the villain in a movie instead of the hero.
Never have I ever blamed autocorrect for a message I 100% typed on purpose.
Never have I ever broken something and quietly put it back hoping the next person would think they broke it.
